meta_description: MJB Electrical Services in Birmingham. Qualified electrician offering domestic and commercial electrical work. NICEIC registered. Call 07941 746878 for a free quote.
hero_subhead: From faulty sockets to full rewires, we fix electrical problems fast and get you back to normal.
services_subhead: Whether it's emergency repairs, new installations, or full property rewiring, we handle domestic and commercial electrical work with precision.

services.title: Emergency Electrical Repairs
services.desc: Trip switches, blown fuses, dead outlets, and faulty wiring fixed fast. We attend call-outs within 48 hours and carry common replacement parts on the van.

services.title: Full House Rewiring
services.desc: Old, dangerous, or outdated wiring replaced to modern safety standards. Perfect for period properties or homes built before 1980s regulations.

services.title: New Installations & Extensions
services.desc: Kitchen and bathroom circuits, garden electrics, EV charging points, and loft lighting. All work complies with Building Regulations and comes with certification.

services.title: Fault Finding & Testing
services.desc: Can't find the fault? We use diagnostic equipment to locate the problem, then repair it. Includes Pat testing for commercial premises.

services.title: Consumer Unit & Earthing Upgrades
services.desc: Replace old fuse boxes with modern safety switches. Upgrades protect your family and are often required by insurance companies.

services.title: Commercial Electrical Maintenance
services.desc: Planned maintenance, compliance checks, and emergency repairs for shops, offices, and small industrial units across the West Midlands.

about_pullquote: I became an electrician to help people get safe, reliable electrics without the big-company price tag.
about_para_1: MJB Electrical Services was founded in 2006 by Mark Johnson, a fully qualified electrician with nearly two decades' experience in domestic and commercial electrical work across Birmingham and the wider West Midlands. We're NICEIC registered and Part P certified, meaning every installation meets Building Regulations and comes with proper certification.
about_para_2: We've built our reputation on being straightforward, reliable, and fair. You won't find hidden charges or pressure sales here — just honest advice and skilled work. Hundreds of Birmingham homeowners and local businesses trust us to fix faults quickly and install new electrics to last.

reviews.text: Mark came out to fix a tripping electrics problem we'd had for weeks. He was there on time, diagnosed it straight away, and had it sorted in under an hour. Very professional, reasonable price. Can't recommend him highly enough.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: Just had our kitchen completely rewired and two new circuits added. Brilliant job, kept the mess to a minimum, and all the paperwork was done properly. Mark explained everything clearly. Will definitely use him again.
reviews.author: Helen T.

reviews.text: Emergency call-out after a socket caught fire in our hallway. Mark was round within 48 hours, very calm and reassuring. Fixed the fault and gave us proper advice. He's got our number on speed dial now.
reviews.author: Michael S.
